text: Would you rather sit in the circle than help run the game?
Would you rather make the game kinder than make it stranger?
Do you like to arrive late and leave early?
Do you want to win with the town?
Are you secretly working against the town?
Do you want to be the one doing the killing?
Would you rather help your team than get in its way?
Do you like the classics best?
Do you like a game full of deaths and last-minute saves?
Do you enjoy madness and characters that change?
Do you like trying things that are new and untested?
Do you want to be woken on the very first night?
Are you happy to be woken up night after night?
Do you like changing the game before it has even begun?
Would you save your power for one big moment?
Would you rather start the game already holding a clue?
Do you play to learn things, more than to do things?
Do you like to point at someone and see what happens?
Is death never far from your mind?
Do you come alive when the nominations start?
Can you keep up a story you know isn't true?
Do you suspect that nothing anyone hears can be trusted?
Do you see the world in terms of good and evil?
